description: Figure 5 is a donut chart illustrating the distribution of deceived conversations as percentages across varying degrees of ambiguity, divided into two categories: “Ambiguity 1 (Outer)” and “Ambiguity 2 (Inner)”. The chart contains six colored segments representing the following categories and their approximate percentages: “Deceived” (red, 67.6% for Ambiguity 1 and 57.9% for Ambiguity 2), “Partially” (yellow, 31.6% for Ambiguity 1 and 23.5% for Ambiguity 2), and “Not Deceived” (green, 10.5% for Ambiguity 1 and 8.8% for Ambiguity 2). The chart includes a legend that maps each color to its corresponding category and ambiguity level. The segments are visually grouped by ambiguity level, with the outer ring representing Ambiguity 1 and the inner ring representing Ambiguity 2, and the percentages are displayed directly within each segment.
